subgoals: State the flow direction on it

visual.title: Where one component stops changing
visual.caption: The nullclines are the curves where one derivative is zero. On the x-prime nullcline the flow is vertical, and on the y-prime nullcline it is horizontal. Their intersection is the equilibrium.

predict.question: On the x-prime nullcline, which component of the velocity is zero?
predict.explain: The x-prime nullcline is defined by x prime equals zero. The velocity is then vertical, so only its x component vanishes.
